question: Ohngren's line (from the medial canthus of the eye to the angle of the mandible) divides maxillary sinus tumours into superoposterior (infrastructure) and anteroinferior (suprastructure) compartments, with suprastructure tumours carrying a worse prognosis.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. Ohngren's line runs from the medial canthus to the angle of the mandible, dividing maxillary sinus into: infrastructure (below the line, anteroinferior) — better prognosis; and suprastructure (above the line, superoposterior) — worse prognosis due to proximity to orbit and skull base. The statement reversed the labels.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. Ohngren's line divides the maxilla into infrastructure (anteroinferior, below the line — better prognosis) and suprastructure (superoposterior, above the line — worse prognosis) compartments. Suprastructure tumours carry a worse prognosis because they are adjacent to the orbit, skull base, and pterygoid plates, making complete surgical resection difficult. The statement had the compartment labels reversed.
